title: Subagent recovery after MAX_TURNS is reported as GOAL success, hiding interruption

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue report is high quality, clear, and actionable. It includes a specific bug description, detailed reproduction context from session logs, exact version numbers, expected vs actual behavior, and an accurate diagnosis of internal termination reason inconsistency.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: This is a localized logic issue in `packages/core/src/agents/local-executor.ts` where recovery turn success unconditionally overrides `terminateReason` to `GOAL`. Fixing it requires updating termination reason tracking during recovery and updating existing unit tests in `packages/core/src/agents/local-executor.test.ts`.

summary.problem: When a subagent reaches MAX_TURNS and calls complete_task during the final grace recovery turn, LocalAgentExecutor overrides terminateReason to GOAL, causing the tool result and session logs to report 'Termination Reason: GOAL' and status 'success' despite the interruption.
summary.root_cause: In LocalAgentExecutor.runInternal(), successful grace-period recovery unconditionally sets terminateReason = AgentTerminateMode.GOAL, masking the original limit condition (MAX_TURNS or TIMEOUT) that triggered the recovery turn.
summary.context: The final warning recovery mechanism gives subagents a grace period to wrap up and call complete_task, but overwriting the termination mode to GOAL hides the turn limit interruption from parent agent invocations and session logs.

steps: In packages/core/src/agents/local-executor.ts, update runInternal() (and timeout catch blocks) so that successful recovery after hitting execution limits (MAX_TURNS or TIMEOUT) preserves the original limit termination reason rather than setting terminateReason to AgentTerminateMode.GOAL.
Ensure LocalAgentExecutor returns the original limit-based terminate_reason in the OutputObject so downstream consumers like LocalSubagentInvocation properly report MAX_TURNS or TIMEOUT.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When a subagent exceeds MAX_TURNS and calls complete_task in the recovery turn, the returned terminate_reason is MAX_TURNS rather than GOAL.
verification_steps: Update unit tests in packages/core/src/agents/local-executor.test.ts that test grace turn recovery after MAX_TURNS to assert output.terminate_reason is MAX_TURNS.
Run vitest on packages/core/src/agents/local-executor.test.ts to verify all test cases pass.
